Customer Data Privacy Policy

Document ID: Policy_C19_privacy_policy

Category: C19 — Privacy & Data Protection

Department: Legal

Customer Scope: all

Version: 1.0    Last Updated: 2026-08-08    Source Authority: Internal Knowledge Base

1. Purpose

Describes how NovaTel collects, uses, retains, and protects customer personal data, and the rights available to customers.

2. Data We Collect

KYC identity and address data

Call Detail Records (CDRs) and data-usage records

Billing and payment data

Location data derived from network signalling (for service and regulatory purposes)

3. Use of Data

Data is used for service delivery, billing, fraud prevention, network optimisation, legal/regulatory compliance, and — where consented — personalised marketing.

4. Retention

CDRs and KYC records are retained for the statutory minimum period mandated by licence conditions, even after account closure or a data-deletion request.

5. Customer Rights

Customers may request access to, correction of, or deletion of their personal data (subject to statutory retention exceptions) via Privacy Settings in the app.
